overrides: New explicitly authorized variable compact families supersede the single 6x6 footprint. Keep the accepted high-45-degree frontal-top camera, all edges axis aligned. No heavy black outline, realistic brick texture, stretching, or image-height-based construction percentage.
normalization: One common aspect-preserving source frame derived from stage 5; identical transform for all stages; nearest-neighbour scaling, hard alpha and palette quantization only. Never redraw geometry, warp axes, or independently recenter a reverse stage.
